Misses '''Ikk''' was an [[Ithorian]] inhabitant of the isolated [[planet]] of [[At Attin]], whose population was dedicated to the [[Great Work]] of producing [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. During the [[New Republic Era]], Misses Ikk resided in the same suburban neighborhood as the [[human]] [[Gender|boy]] [[Wim]], who tended to startle her [[Ikk's frogdog|frogdog]] as he rushed to [[At Attin Middle School Gamma|school]] at the last [[Time|minute]].

Around [[9 ABY]], At Attin was [[Invasion of At Attin|invaded]] by [[Silvo's pirates]], who intended to subjugate the planet's population and profit from credit production. As the invaders rounded up the townsfolk, [[pirate]] [[Beef]] approached Misses Ikk, knocked her over, and hauled her back to her feet before cruelly walking her to the rest of the inhabitants. However, due to the actions of the [[Skeleton Crew]], the [[Barrier]] that isolated At Attin was soon disabled, allowing a [[New Republic]] [[squadron]] to arrive on the planet and repel the pirate invasion.

==Biography==
===Walks and mishaps beyond the Barrier===
{{Quote|Sorry, Misses Ikk!|Wim to Misses Ikk|<ref name="SC 101" />|audio=Sorry-Ikk.mp3}}
[[File:BarkingFrogDog-SC1.png|thumb|right|250px|Wim disrupts Misses Ikk's morning walk with her frogdog.]]
Misses Ikk was a [[Gender|female]] [[Ithorian]] who lived on the [[planet]] of [[At Attin]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 101" /> A world isolated from the rest of [[the galaxy]] by a giant [[gas]] [[Barrier]], At Attin accommodated [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] mints<ref name="SC 108">{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}}</ref> and was therefore known as a [[Jewels of the Old Republic|Jewel of the Old Republic]].<ref name="SC 103">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}}</ref> The population of the planet was dedicated to the so-called [[Great Work]],<ref name="SC 101" /> which referred to the maintenance of the mints and the production of the credits ''per se''.<ref name="SC 107">{{SkeletonCrew|We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble}}</ref> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> Ikk resided in the suburbs of a larger [[Unidentified city (At Attin)|metropolian settlement]].<ref name="SC 101" /> She<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> lived in the same neighborhood as the [[human]] [[Systems Coordinator]] [[Wendle]] and<ref name="SC 101" /> his<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> minor son [[Wim]], as well as a<ref name="SC 101" /> [[Myykian]]<ref name="Blevins:2025">{{WebCite|url=https://collider.com/star-wars-skeleton-crew-neel-species-myykian-explained|text=We Finally Officially Know What Species Neel Is in 'Star Wars: Skeleton Crew' [Exclusive]|author=Blevins, Adam|date=2025-01-16|work=[[Wikipedia:Valnet#Collider|''Collider'']]|archivedate=20250116235915}}</ref> multi-[[Youngling|child]] [[Neel's family|family]]. At that [[time]], Ikk possessed an [[At Attin frogdog]] which she would walk on a leash as part of her morning<ref name="SC 101" /> and evening routine.<ref name="SC 108 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref>

Around 9 ABY, Misses Ikk was taking her [[Ikk's frogdog|frogdog]] for a morning walk, keeping<ref name="SC 101" /> him<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> on a leash. All of a sudden, the boy Wim ran out of his [[Wim's home|house]] with a toy in his [[Limb|hand]] and rushed past a [[maintenance droid]] operating a [[lawnmower]]. Failing to keep his distance, Wim got too close to Ikk's pet, prompting him to bark at him and intruding on a neighbor's propery. In response, Misses Ikk rebuked the youngster in her native [[Ithorese]]. Without stopping, Wim called out an apology from a distance as he hurried off to catch his [[school tram]].<ref name="SC 101" />

The next [[Standard day|day]] brought rainy weather. In the morning, Misses Ikk set off on her routine walk with her frogdog, once again keeping him on a leash. As she passed by Wim's house, she saw the youngster rush out of his garage on his [[Wim's hoverbike|hoverbike]].<ref name="SC 101" /> Careening unsteadily down the road,<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> he splashed [[water]] on the adjacent sidewalks and startled Misses Ikk's pet again, causing him to step onto the roadway as Misses Ikk held on to the leash.<ref name="SC 101" />

===A walk interrupted by pirate invasion===
{{Quote|They work for us! Making credits! ''[laughs]|Beef, knocking down Misses Ikk|<ref name="SC 108" />|audio=TheyWorkForUs.mp3}}
[[File:Ikk_during_invasion.png|thumb|left|250px|Misses Ikk and her frogdog during the invasion]]
Unbeknownst to Misses Ikk, Wim accidentally left At Attin alongside a few young companions the next evening.<ref name="SC 101" /> The children found themselves stranded in the galaxy and had trouble finding their way back home. In [[Borgo Prime|Starport Borgo]], the younglings allied themselves with the [[pirate]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]], who promised to help them return to their [[Homeworld|homeplanet]].<ref name="SC 103" /> However, the pirate ultimately betrayed them. Upon their arrival on the planet, he posed as a Galactic Republic emissary to be granted an audience with [[the Supervisor]], a [[droid]] responsible for governing At Attin and overseeing the Great Work. By disabling the machine, Jod caused a large-scale power outage before he allowed his [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]] to access the planet, launching a planetary [[Invasion of At Attin|invasion]] to subjugate the At Attin inhabitants and profit from credit production.<ref name="SC 108" />

Misses Ikk happened to be out for a walk with her frogdog<ref name="SC 108 AD" /> when the massive [[Silvo's pirate frigate|pirate frigate]] appeared in the dark sky,<ref name="SC 108" /> its [[turbolaser]] [[cannon]]s set in battle-ready position.<ref name="SC 108 AD" /> The frogdog barked up at the invasive [[Starship|craft]] before it began firing on the planet's surface, destroying road vehicles in the process. Landing on their [[pirate dropship]]s, the assault team rounded up the townsfolk. As citizens fled through the streets, the pirate [[Beef]] knocked Misses Ikk over, only to haul her back to her feet and walk her to the rest of the captured citizens. Beef escorted the neighbors<ref name="SC 108" /> himself.<ref name="SC 102 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> Separated from her pet, Misses Ikk ambled alongside [[Garree]], [[Maree]], the Myykian family, and other neighbors when she heard a public address by Silvo. Announcing that he had taken control of the planet, the pirate [[captain]] promised his men would show mercy to the inhabitants if they followed his orders, warning that any act of defiance would be punished severely.<ref name="SC 108" />

[[File:Blinded_by_the_Barrier.png|thumb|250px|Misses Ikk and her neighbors blinded by an aurora]]
As the citizens were rounded up by the pirate assault teams,<ref name="SC 108" /> the [[Skeleton Crew]]<ref name="T19XifsgFS0">{{SWYouTube|T19XifsgFS0|Skeleton Crew | Blast from the Past | Streaming Dec 2 on Disney+}}</ref>—comprising [[Fern]], [[KB]], [[Neel]], and Wim—sprang into action to seek help from the [[New Republic]]. While KB managed to slip past the Barrier to contact the [[astronomer]] [[Kh'ymm]], Fern and Wim—along with their parents, [[Fara]] and Wendle—worked to disable it from the [[Supervisor's Tower]]. Meanwhile, Misses Ikk and her captured companions watched as a series of explosions rippled across the sky, causing the ribbons of green gas to dissipate as the Barrier burned away. Shielding her [[eye]]s from a brilliant aurora coursing over the neighborhood, Misses Ikk turned to the side. The Barrier soon vanished altogether, revealing a night sky filled with [[star]]s. As Misses Ikk and other neighbors looked up, they saw a New Republic [[squadron]] arriving to the rescue. The [[starfighter]]s launched an immediate attack on the invading frigate, sending it crashing into a nearby water canal. The citizen erupted into thunderous applause as the pirates fell back in retreat, faced with imminent defeat. Meanwhile, a New Republic [[CR90 corvette]] cruised over the city rooftops, and one by one, the lights began to flicker back on.<ref name="SC 108" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:AtAttinFrogdog-SCPatchRelics.png|thumb|right|200px|Misses Ikk's loyal and attentive frogdog]]
A member of the [[Sentience|sentient]] Ithorian [[species]], Misses Ikk had long hands ending in claw-like fingers and thick, column-like legs. Her head featured two [[mouth]]s on the opposite sides and a hammer-like, arching protrusion with two small, rounded eyestalks. She walked slowly and unsteadily<ref name="SC 101" /> and was prone to stumbling.<ref name="SC 108" />

A speaker of the Ithorese [[language]],<ref name="SC 101" /> Misses Ikk was anatomically incapable of using [[Galactic Basic Standard]]. However, unlike several other Ithorians,<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> she did not utilize<ref name="SC 101" /> a [[translator collar]], which would have allowed her to communicate in Basic.<ref name="BB 107 EG">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/battle-scars-episode-guide|text="Battle Scars" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref> An owner of an At Attin frogdog,<ref name="SC 101" /> a species known for being loyal and attentive,<ref name="At Attin frogdog">{{Databank|at-attin-frogdog|At Attin frogdog}}</ref> Misses Ikk would become upset if someone startled him or made him bark unnecessarily.<ref name="SC 101" />

==Equipment==
During the New Republic Era, Misses Ikk wore a loose-fitting, [[Color|pink]] [[Clothing|robe]] reaching down to her feet, with separate pantlegs covering her lower limbs. On top of the pink robe, Ikk sported a brown vest. In addition, she owned a leash which she used for walks with her frogdog.<ref name="SC 101" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:IthoriansInTheMaking.jpg|thumb|right|''Skeleton Crew'' Ithorians in the making]]
Misses Ikk made her [[canon]]ical debut in the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]],"<ref name="SC 101" /> which premiered on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref> Her performance artist in the series was [[Cary Gunnar Lee]],<ref name="SC 101" /> with [[Legacy Effects]] developing the creature suit.<ref name="LE">{{WebCite|url=https://www.legacyefx.com/skeleton-crew|text=Skeleton Crew|work=[[Legacy Effects]]|archivedate=20250226013146}}</ref> Before the premiere of the show, the character was first pictured in the official trailer of the series, which was released on [[August 9]], 2024.<ref name="a6voXgBlmpk">{{SWYouTube|a6voXgBlmpk|Skeleton Crew | Official Trailer | Streaming December 3 on Disney+}}</ref>
